articles.title: Ratcliffe's Ineos Group settles £10m-plus claim with Ainslie's firm over yacht
articles.summary: A company connected to Sir Jim Ratcliffe's Ineos Group said it has settled a High Court claim against a firm founded by Sir Ben Ainslie.

articles.title: Who is the best female tennis player of 2026?
articles.summary: Tim Henman and Jamie Murray discuss who they think is the best female tennis player this year.

articles.title: Hutchinson celebration results in season-ending injury
articles.summary: Detroit Lions star Aidan Hutchinson has been ruled out for the season after suffering a knee injury while celebrating a sack against the New England Patriots.

articles.title: Patriots QB Maye feared to be out for season with ankle injury
articles.summary: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye could miss the remainder of the 2026 NFL season after suffering a suspected ankle fracture in Sunday's loss to the Detroit Lions.
